title: Snowflake + Mastech Digital Bengaluru Community Meet
venue: The Liverpool Blue Hotels, 6th floor, opp. Myntra Head Office, Kadubeesanahalli, Outer Ring Road
organizer: Snowflake Bengaluru User Group x Mastech Digital
audience: Data engineers and analysts with at least one year of Snowflake experience
description: Snowflake user group morning with Mastech Digital: ontology on Snowflake, governance with Snowflake CoCo, building a Cortex Agent with Cortex Code prompts, Redshift-to-Snowflake migration and Iceberg with Horizon governance. Listed as sold out.

title: ObservabilityCON on the Road: Bengaluru 2026
description: Grafana Labs' one-day observability conference: keynote from the Office of the CTO, Grafana Assistant and autonomous operations, observability for AI agents, Grafana Cloud cost and scale, and customer talks from NeoSapien and Simplismart.

title: Cockroach Connect Bengaluru
audience: Infrastructure architects, engineering and platform leaders, CTOs and technology executives
description: Curated evening with a keynote from CEO Spencer Kimball, a technical deep dive, customer sessions and panel, and a partner fireside chat, followed by a networking dinner.

title: Build Your First Collaborative AI Agent in Microsoft Teams
venue: Microsoft India R&D, Luxor North Tower, Bagmane Capital Campus, Doddanekkundi
description: Free hands-on workshop led by Microsoft engineers on building collaborative AI agents that take part in Teams conversations and understand shared context.

title: Intuit India AI Summit 2026
price: Not stated (registration requests reviewed by AIM)
description: Half-day summit organised by Intuit, themed 'From Insights to Action: The future of intelligence', on AI that anticipates outcomes and runs workflows with humans in the loop. Confirmed speakers come from Hyperbots, JioHotstar, Glance and Tally Solutions.

title: StackConnect World Tour: Elevating QE with Agentic AI - Bengaluru Edition
audience: QA and quality-engineering leaders and teams
description: BrowserStack's full-day QE conference: AI-in-testing keynote, a panel on scaling test automation with AI, live product demos and a test-management session.
